title: COTOP Electric Hand Warmers 2-Pack — Rechargeable, up to 55 °C
short_description: 2 rechargeable hand warmers with charging case: 3 heat levels up to 55 °C, warm on both sides, USB-C charging. Ideal for winter camping, hiking and as a gift.
long_description: The COTOP set (model N2) contains two electric hand warmers and a charging case. Each warmer heats on both sides and offers three heat levels up to 55 °C. It charges via USB-C, and according to the manufacturer the battery has 14,000 mAh. Unlike disposable warmers, they are reusable. A charging cable and user manual are also included. Practical for cold nights while winter camping, for hikes, stadium visits or as a gift for outdoor fans.
buying_angle: Practical for campers and hikers who want warm hands in the cold – and a great gift idea for outdoor fans.
